conditioned by eye-contact, there is an aggregate of volitional formations that is wholesome, unwholesome, or indeterminate; it is either of the sense sphere, the fine-material sphere, the immaterial sphere, or not included [within the spheres].
Conditioned by ear-contact ... [and so on] ... [up to] mind-contact.
Conditioned by nose-contact …pe… conditioned by tongue-contact …pe… conditioned by body-contact …pe…

Conditioned by mind-contact, there is the aggregate of volitional formations (*saṅkhārakkhandha*): it is wholesome, unwholesome, or indeterminate; it belongs to the sense sphere, the fine-material sphere, or the immaterial sphere; or it is not included [within the realms].
There is volition born of eye-contact, volition born of ear-contact, volition born of nose-contact, volition born of tongue-contact, volition born of body-contact, and volition born of mind-contact.
Thus is the aggregate of volitional formations manifold.
Furthermore, the aggregate of formations is of many kinds:
there is an aggregate of formations conditioned by eye-contact that is associated with pleasant feeling;
there is one associated with painful feeling; there is one associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling... [and so on] ...there is.
There is [contact] with an internal object, there is [contact] with an external object, there is [contact] with both an internal and external object;

there is [contact] pertaining to the sense-sphere, there is [contact] pertaining to the fine-material sphere, there is [contact] pertaining to the immaterial sphere, and there is [contact] that is not included [within the three realms]; conditioned by ear-contact … pe … [and so on].
Conditioned by nose-contact …pe… conditioned by tongue-contact …pe… conditioned by body-contact …pe…
Conditioned by mind-contact, there is the aggregate of volitional formations associated with pleasant feeling … [and so on] … there is that which has an internal object,

there is that which has an external object, there is that which has both an internal and external object; there is that which belongs to the sense sphere, there is that which belongs to the fine-material sphere,
there is that which belongs to the immaterial sphere, and there is that which is not included [within the three realms].
Volition born of eye-contact, volition born of ear-contact, volition born of nose-contact, volition born of tongue-contact, volition born of body-contact, and volition born of mind-contact.
Thus, by way of many kinds, is the aggregate of formations.
This is called the aggregate of formations.
2.5. The Aggregate of Consciousness (Viññāṇakkhandha).
Therein, what is the aggregate of consciousness?
The aggregate of consciousness is of one kind: [consciousness].
Associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that which is with root-cause, and there is that which is without root-cause.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is the wholesome, there is the unwholesome, and there is the indeterminate.
The aggregate of consciousness is fourfold:

There is that which belongs to the sense sphere, there is that which belongs to the fine-material sphere, there is that which belongs to the immaterial sphere, and there is that which is not included [within the realms].
The aggregate of consciousness is fivefold:

there is that associated with the faculty of pleasure, there is that associated with the faculty of pain, there is that associated with the faculty of mental joy, there is that associated with the faculty of mental grief, and there is that associated with the faculty of equanimity.
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of fivefold division.
By way of sixfold division, the aggregate of consciousness consists of:
eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness.
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of sixfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of sevenfold division is:
eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, the mind-element, and the mind-consciousness-element.
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of sevenfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of eightfold division:

eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness (which is accompanied by pleasure), body-consciousness (which is accompanied by pain), mind-element, and mind-consciousness-element.
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of eightfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of ninefold division:

eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, the mind-element, and the mind-consciousness-element—which is either wholesome, unwholesome, or indeterminate.
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of ninefold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division:
eye-consciousness … [and so on] … [up to] mind-consciousness.
Body-consciousness is accompanied by pleasure; it is accompanied by pain. The mind-element and the mind-consciousness-element are wholesome, unwholesome, or indeterminate.
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division. The aggregate of consciousness by way of a singlefold division: [is that which is consciousness].
Associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that which is with root-cause, and there is that which is without root-cause.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is that associated with pleasant feeling, there is that associated with painful feeling, and there is that associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.
There is that which is fruition, there is that which is subject to fruition, and there is that which is neither fruition nor subject to fruition.
There is that which is acquired and subject to clinging; there is that which is not acquired but subject to clinging; there is that which is neither acquired nor subject to clinging.
There is that which is defiled and subject to defilement; there is that which is undefiled but subject to defilement;

there is that which is neither defiled nor subject to defilement. There is that which is accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought; there is that which is without applied thought and has only sustained thought; there is that which is without applied thought and without sustained thought.
There is that accompanied by rapture, there is that accompanied by pleasure, and there is that accompanied by equanimity.
There is that to be abandoned by vision, there is that to be abandoned by cultivation, and there is that to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation.

There is that whose root is to be abandoned by vision, there is that whose root is to be abandoned by cultivation, and there is that whose root is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation.
There is that which leads to accumulation; there is that which leads to diminution; there is that which leads neither to accumulation nor to diminution.
There is that which pertains to the learner; there is that which pertains to the one beyond learning; there is that which pertains neither to the learner nor to the one beyond learning.
There is that which is limited; there is that which is exalted; there is that which is immeasurable.
There is that which has a limited object; there is that which has a sublime object; there is that which has an immeasurable object.
There is that which is inferior; there is that which is intermediate;
there is that which is superior. There is that which is fixed in the wrong way; there is that which is fixed in the right way; there is that which is undetermined.
There is that which has the Path as its object; there is that which has the Path as its cause; there is that which has the Path as its predominance.
There is that which has arisen; there is that which has not yet arisen; there is that which is destined to arise.
There is that which is past; there is that which is future; there is that which is present.
There is [consciousness] that has a past object; there is that which has a future object; there is that which has a present object.
There is that which is internal; there is that which is external; there is that which is both internal and external.
There is that which has an internal object; there is that which has an external object; there is that which has an internal-external object ... and so forth.
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold classification.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of a singlefold classification:
associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that associated with a root, and there is that dissociated from a root.
There is that which is not a root but has a root, and there is that which is neither a root nor has a root.
There is that which is mundane; there is that which is supramundane.
There is that which is cognizable by someone; there is that which is not cognizable by anyone.
There is that which is with taints; there is that which is without taints.
There is that which is associated with the taints; there is that which is dissociated from the taints.
There is that which is dissociated from the taints yet accompanied by taints; there is that which is dissociated from the taints and free from taints.
There is that which is conducive to fetters; there is that which is not conducive to fetters.
There is that which is associated with the fetters; there is that which is dissociated from the fetters.
There is that which is dissociated from the fetters yet is subject to the fetters; there is that which is dissociated from the fetters and is not subject to the fetters.
There is that which is conducive to the knots; there is that which is not conducive to the knots.
There is that which is associated with the fetters; there is that which is dissociated from the fetters.

There is that which is dissociated from the fetters but conducive to the fetters; there is that which is dissociated from the fetters and not conducive to the fetters. There is that which is conducive to the floods; there is that which is not conducive to the floods.

There is that which is associated with the floods; there is that which is dissociated from the floods. There is that which is dissociated from the floods but is subject to the floods; there is that which is dissociated from the floods and is not subject to the floods. There is that which is subject to the yokes;
there is that which is not subject to the yokes.
There is that which is associated with the yokes; there is that which is dissociated from the yokes.
There is that which is dissociated from the yokes but bound by them; there is that which is dissociated from the yokes and not bound by them.
There is that which is conducive to the hindrances; there is that which is not conducive to the hindrances.
There is that which is associated with the hindrances; there is that which is dissociated from the hindrances.
There is that which is dissociated from the hindrances but is subject to them; there is that which is dissociated from the hindrances and is not subject to them.
There is that which is misapprehended; there is that which is not misapprehended.

There is that which is associated with grasping; there is that which is dissociated from grasping. There is that which is dissociated from grasping but misapprehended by it; there is that which is dissociated from grasping and not misapprehended by it. There is that which is clung to; there is that which is not clung to.

There is that which is subject to clinging; there is that which is not subject to clinging. There is that which is associated with clinging; there is that which is dissociated from clinging. There is that which is dissociated from clinging yet subject to clinging; there is that which is dissociated from clinging and not subject to clinging.
There is that which is subject to defilement; there is that which is not subject to defilement.
There is that which is defiled; there is that which is undefiled.
There is that which is associated with defilement; there is that which is dissociated from defilement.
There is that which is dissociated from the defilements yet subject to defilement; there is that which is dissociated from the defilements and not subject to defilement.
There is that which is to be abandoned by vision; there is that which is not to be abandoned by vision.
There is that which is to be abandoned by cultivation; there is that which is not to be abandoned by cultivation.
There is that which has a root to be abandoned by vision; there is that which does not have a root to be abandoned by vision.
There is that which has a root to be abandoned by cultivation; there is that which does not have a root to be abandoned by cultivation.
There is that which is accompanied by applied thought; there is that which is without applied thought.
There is that with investigation, there is that without investigation.
There is that accompanied by rapture, there is that without rapture. There is that associated with rapture, there is that not associated with rapture.
There is that accompanied by pleasure, and there is that not accompanied by pleasure.
There is that accompanied by equanimity, and there is that not accompanied by equanimity.
There is that belonging to the sense sphere, and there is that not belonging to the sense sphere.
There is that which belongs to the form realm, and there is that which does not belong to the form realm.

There is that which belongs to the formless realm, and there is that which does not belong to the formless realm; there is that which is included within the mundane, and there is that which is not included within the mundane.
There is that which leads to liberation, and there is that which does not lead to liberation.
There is the determined, there is the undetermined.
There is that which has a superior, there is that which is unsurpassed.
There is that with conflict, there is that without conflict.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is wholesome, there is unwholesome, and there is indeterminate ... [and so on] ...
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness tenfold.
The aggregate of consciousness is of one kind:
associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is of two kinds:
There is with-conflict; there is without-conflict.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is that associated with pleasant feeling, there is that associated with painful feeling, and there is that associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.
There is resultant... [and so on] ... there is that with internal object, there is that with external object, there is that with both internal and external object...
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division.
This concludes the section based on dyads.
The aggregate of consciousness is of one kind:
associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is of two kinds:
There is that which has a cause; there is that which is without a cause.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is the wholesome, there is the unwholesome, and there is the indeterminate ... [and so on].
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of a singlefold division:
associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that associated with a root-cause, and there is that dissociated from a root-cause ... pe ... it is with conflict, and it is without conflict.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold: ... pe ... [it is past, present, or future].
There is wholesome, there is unwholesome, there is indeterminate ... [and so on] ...
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of singlefold division:
Associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that which is with root-cause, and there is that which is without root-cause.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is that associated with pleasant feeling, there is that associated with painful feeling, and there is that associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.

There is that which is kamma-resultant ... [and so on] ... there is that with internal object, there is that with external object, and there is that with both internal and external objects ... [and so on].
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of a singlefold division:
associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that associated with a root-cause, and there is that dissociated from a root-cause ... [and so on] ... there is that with conflict, and there is that without conflict.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold: ... [and so on] ...
There is that which has an internal object, there is that which has an external object, and there is that which has both an internal and external object... [and so on]...
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division.
This concludes the section based on the triad.
The aggregate of consciousness is of one kind:
associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is of two kinds:
There is that which is with cause; there is that which is without cause.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is the wholesome, there is the unwholesome, and there is the indeterminate …pe….
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of a singlefold division:
associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that associated with roots, and there is that dissociated from roots.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
There is that associated with pleasant feeling; there is that associated with painful feeling; there is that associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling...
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of a singlefold division:
Associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that which is not a root but is accompanied by roots, and there is that which is not a root and is without roots.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is that which is kamma-result, there is that which is of the nature to produce kamma-result, and there is that which is neither kamma-result nor of the nature to produce kamma-result ...
[and so on] ... Thus is the aggregate of consciousness tenfold.
The aggregate of consciousness is of one kind:
associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is of two kinds:
There is that which is mundane; there is that which is supramundane.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is that which is clung-to and subject to clinging; there is that which is not clung-to but subject to clinging; there is that which is neither clung-to nor subject to clinging... [and so on].
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of a singlefold division:
associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that which is cognizable by something, and there is that which is not cognizable by anything.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold: ...
There is that which is defiled and subject to defilement; there is that which is undefiled but subject to defilement; there is that which is undefiled and not subject to defilement ...
[and so on] ... Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division.
By way of a singlefold division, the aggregate of consciousness is:
Associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that which is with taints, and there is that which is without taints.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is that with applied thought and sustained thought; there is that without applied thought and with sustained thought only; there is that without applied thought and without sustained thought...
[and so on]... Thus is the aggregate of consciousness tenfold.
The aggregate of consciousness is of one kind:
associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is of two kinds:
There is that which is associated with the taints; there is that which is dissociated from the taints.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is that accompanied by rapture, there is that accompanied by pleasure, and there is that accompanied by equanimity... [and so on].
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of a singlefold division:
associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that which is dissociated from the taints yet subject to taints; there is that which is dissociated from the taints and free from taints.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
There is that which is to be abandoned by seeing; there is that which is to be abandoned by cultivation; there is that which is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by cultivation ...
[and so on] ... Thus is the aggregate of consciousness tenfold.
The aggregate of consciousness is also singlefold:
Associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that which is subject to the fetters, and there is that which is not subject to the fetters.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:

there is that which has a root to be abandoned by vision, there is that which has a root to be abandoned by cultivation, and there is that which has no root to be abandoned either by vision or by cultivation...
[and so on] ... Thus is the aggregate of consciousness tenfold.
The aggregate of consciousness is of one kind:
associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is of two kinds:
There is that which is associated with the fetters; there is that which is dissociated from the fetters.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is that which leads to accumulation, there is that which leads to diminution, and there is that which leads neither to accumulation nor to diminution... [and so on].
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold classification.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of a singlefold classification:
associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that which is dissociated from the fetters but is subject to them; there is that which is dissociated from the fetters and is not subject to them.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold: [and so forth].

There is that which is in training (sekha), there is that which is beyond training (asekha), and there is that which is neither-in-training-nor-beyond-training … [and so on] … Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division. The aggregate of consciousness by way of a singlefold division: [is that which is associated with the root of greed].
Associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that which is subject to the ties, and there is that which is not subject to the ties.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is the limited, there is the exalted, and there is the immeasurable ... [as above] ...
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness tenfold.
The aggregate of consciousness is of one kind:
associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is of two kinds:
There is that which is associated with the fetters; there is that which is dissociated from the fetters.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is that which has a limited object, there is that which has a sublime object, and there is that which has an immeasurable object... [and so forth].
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of a singlefold division:
that which is associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that which is dissociated from the fetters yet bound by them; there is that which is dissociated from the fetters and not bound by them.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold: [and so forth].
There is the inferior, there is the intermediate, there is the superior … [as above] … Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of a singlefold division:
Associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that which is subject to the floods, and there is that which is not subject to the floods.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is that which is fixed in falsehood, there is that which is fixed in rightness, and there is that which is undetermined ...
[and so on] ... Thus is the aggregate of consciousness tenfold.
The aggregate of consciousness is of one kind:
associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is of two kinds:
There is that which is associated with the floods; there is that which is dissociated from the floods.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is that which has the Path as its object, there is that which has the Path as its cause, and there is that which has the Path as its predominance. ... [and so on] ...
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of a singlefold division:
associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that which is dissociated from the floods but is subject to the floods; there is that which is dissociated from the floods and is not subject to the floods.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold: [and so forth].
There is that which has arisen, there is that which has not yet arisen, there is that which is subject to arising ... [and so on] ...
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of a singlefold division:
Associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that which is subject to bondage, and there is that which is not subject to bondage.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is that which is past, there is that which is future, and there is that which is present ...
[and so on] ... Thus is the aggregate of consciousness tenfold.
The aggregate of consciousness is of one kind:
associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is of two kinds:
There is that which is associated with the yokes; there is that which is dissociated from the yokes.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is that which has a past object, there is that which has a future object, and there is that which has a present object... [and so on].
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of a singlefold division:
associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that which is dissociated from the yokes but bound by them; there is that which is dissociated from the yokes and not bound by them.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold: [and so forth].
There is internal, there is external, there is both internal and external ... [and so on] ...
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of tenfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of a singlefold division:
Associated with contact.
The aggregate of consciousness is twofold:
there is that which is subject to hindrances, and there is that which is not subject to hindrances.
The aggregate of consciousness is threefold:
there is that which has an internal object, there is that which has an external object, and there is that which has both an internal and external object...
[and so on] ... Thus is the aggregate of consciousness tenfold.
The "Both-Increased" [classification].
The aggregate of consciousness by way of sevenfold division:

there is the wholesome, there is the unwholesome, there is the indeterminate, there is that pertaining to the sense sphere, there is that pertaining to the fine-material sphere, there is that pertaining to the immaterial sphere, and there is that which is not included [within the mundane spheres].
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of sevenfold division.
Furthermore, there is another sevenfold division of the aggregate of consciousness:
there is that associated with pleasant feeling, there is that associated with painful feeling, and there is that associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.

Associated with feeling, there is that which belongs to the sense sphere, there is that which belongs to the fine-material sphere, there is that which belongs to the immaterial sphere, and there is that which is unincluded ...
[and so on] ... there is that which has an internal object, there is that which has an external object, there is that which has both an internal and external object;
there is that which belongs to the sense sphere, there is that which belongs to the fine-material sphere, there is that which belongs to the immaterial sphere, and there is that which is unincluded.
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of sevenfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of twenty-fourfold division:
there is an aggregate of consciousness conditioned by eye-contact that is wholesome, there is one that is unwholesome, and there is one that is indeterminate.
Conditioned by ear-contact … conditioned by nose-contact … conditioned by tongue-contact … [and so forth] …
Conditioned by body-contact …pe… conditioned by mind-contact,
there exists the aggregate of consciousness that is wholesome, there exists that which is unwholesome, and there exists that which is indeterminate:
eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness.
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of twenty-fourfold division.
Furthermore, there is another twenty-fourfold division of the aggregate of consciousness:

there is an aggregate of consciousness conditioned by eye-contact that is associated with pleasant feeling; there is [an aggregate of consciousness conditioned by eye-contact] that is associated with painful feeling... [and so on for the remaining sense bases].

Associated with feeling: there is that associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling … [and so on] … there is that with an internal object, there is that with an external object, there is that with both an internal and external object;
eye-consciousness … [and so on].
body-consciousness, mind-consciousness;
conditioned by ear-contact …pe… conditioned by nose-contact …pe…
Conditioned by tongue-contact …pe… conditioned by body-contact …pe… conditioned by mind-contact,
there is the aggregate of consciousness that has an internal object, there is that which has an external object, and there is that which has both an internal and external object.
Eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness.
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of twenty-fourfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of thirtyfold division:

Conditioned by eye-contact, there is the aggregate of consciousness that belongs to the sense-sphere, there is that which belongs to the fine-material sphere, there is that which belongs to the immaterial sphere, and there is that which is not included [within the spheres];
conditioned by ear-contact … pe … conditioned by nose-contact … pe …
Conditioned by tongue-contact … conditioned by body-contact … conditioned by mind-contact, there is the aggregate of consciousness:

there is that belonging to the sense sphere, there is that belonging to the fine-material sphere, there is that belonging to the immaterial sphere, and there is that which is not included [in the spheres].
Eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness.
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness by way of thirtyfold division.
The aggregate of consciousness by way of manifold division:

Conditioned by eye-contact, there is the aggregate of consciousness: it is wholesome, it is unwholesome, it is indeterminate; it belongs to the sense-sphere, it belongs to the fine-material sphere, it belongs to the immaterial sphere, it is unperturbed; [this includes] eye-consciousness ... pe ... mind-consciousness.
Conditioned by ear-contact ... pe ... [and so on for the other sense bases].
Conditioned by nose-contact …pe… conditioned by tongue-contact …pe… conditioned by body-contact …pe…

Conditioned by mind-contact, there is the aggregate of consciousness that is wholesome, unwholesome, or indeterminate; it belongs to the sense sphere, the fine-material sphere, or the immaterial sphere; and it is not included [in the mundane]. There is eye-consciousness ...
pe ... and mind-consciousness.
Thus is the aggregate of consciousness manifold.
Furthermore, there is the manifold aggregate of consciousness:
there is the aggregate of consciousness conditioned by eye-contact that is associated with pleasant feeling ... [and so on] ...

there is that which has an internal object, there is that which has an external object, there is that which has both an internal and external object, and there is that which belongs to the sense sphere (kāmāvacara).
There is [contact] pertaining to the fine-material sphere, there is [contact] pertaining to the immaterial sphere, and there is [contact] that is not included [within the spheres];
conditioned by ear-contact …pe… conditioned by nose-contact …pe…
Conditioned by tongue-contact …pe… conditioned by body-contact …pe… conditioned by mind-contact,
there exists the aggregate of consciousness associated with pleasant feeling …pe… there exists [unpleasant feeling] …pe… there exists [neutral feeling].
There is that which has an internal object, there is that which has an external object, there is that which has both an internal and external object;

there is that which belongs to the sense-sphere, there is that which belongs to the fine-material sphere, there is that which belongs to the immaterial sphere, and there is that which is not included [within the realms];
there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness.
